reason: I'd maybe let them put my flyers up since it's free, but I wouldn't pay anything. My nights fill through PR people, WhatsApp lists and regulars, and I don't know anyone who uses this app here.
objection: How many people actually use this app here? Until I see real users in my city, a paid plan is money for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a published user count well past 2,000 in my city and proof that people from the app actually walk in on my DJ nights.
